chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from Zurārah, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
“The woman who commits siḥāq is flogged.”

key_terms.تُجْلَدُ: she is flogged; the hadd punishment is carried out upon her
key_terms.قَالَ: he said; introducing the transmitted statement of the Imam

ai.seo_question: What is the legal ruling in Shia hadith on siḥāq between women?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning siḥāq, declaring that the woman who commits it is subject to flogging. It is presented as a concise juridical statement from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام within the chapter on the prescribed punishment for siḥāq.
